integrity: Self-contained modular Fourier argument and complete disjoint-classes reduction. Numerical experiments are corroboration, not substitutes for the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Two-term asymptotic for fixed decimal digit length k tending to infinity only; no uniform arbitrary-bound cutoff result, no prime analogue, no optimal third spectral exponent.
title: A two-scale counting law for decimal integers avoiding their own divisor digits
